summary: Detailed implementation plan for a WooCommerce plugin that connects YITH Request a Quote events to Bale and Eitaa messengers with Persian/RTL PDF generation. Covers 9 phases: environment setup, plugin skeleton, YITH hooks, Action Scheduler queue, API wrappers for both messengers, Dompdf-based Persian PDF generation, message templating, admin settings UI, and distribution prep. Includes file structure, code samples, risk table, timeline estimate, and open questions.
